updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Content Preview in Alerts
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now lets users preview file content directly within alert activity explorer without creating a case, speeding up investigation workflows. This reduces friction for security teams reviewing potential insider threats like data exfiltration or IP theft.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP – Adaptive Scopes for SharePoint
updates.summary: Dynamic adaptive scoping for DLP policies on SharePoint now automatically targets sites based on attributes like URL, name, or custom metadata, eliminating the 100-site static limit and reducing manual maintenance overhead. This enables admins to deploy scalable, automated policies that adjust as site properties evolve.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager – AI-Powered Regulatory Templates
updates.summary: Compliance Manager now uses AI to automatically convert complex PDF regulations into actionable controls and improvement actions across multi-cloud environments. Compliance officers can quickly map regulations to assessments and identify gaps without manual interpretation.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP – Faster Policy Sync (30 minutes)
updates.summary: DLP policy updates now sync across the organization in 30 minutes instead of up to 2 hours, ensuring protection changes take effect faster. This reduces the window where outdated policies remain active and improves incident response time.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Archive SharePoint Files Under Retention
updates.summary: Admins can now add archiving actions to retention policies in SharePoint Online, moving inactive content to low-cost storage while keeping it discoverable and compliant. This extends DLM capabilities beyond keep/delete to include retention-based archiving.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Policy Tips in Outlook for Mac
updates.summary: DLP policy tips now appear in Outlook for Mac mail tips, alerting users to sensitive information violations in real time before send. Users can remove non-compliant recipients or override policies directly from the tip UI.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Policy Tips in Outlook Mobile
updates.summary: DLP policy tips are now available on Outlook Mobile, providing real-time alerts to users when composing emails with sensitive information. This extends mobile compliance enforcement and helps prevent accidental data loss on smartphones and tablets.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – Endpoint DLP Analysis
updates.summary: Security teams can now launch Data Security Investigations directly from endpoint DLP alerts to automatically gather and review exfiltrated files by time, user, and endpoint. This streamlines investigation workflows for suspected data loss incidents.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Retention for Copilot Memory
updates.summary: Admins can now configure retention policies for Microsoft 365 Copilot memory items, preserving historical versions for security, compliance, and investigation purposes. Copilot memory stored in hidden Exchange mailbox folders will support versioning and retention controls.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP – Web Search Protection for Microsoft 365 Copilot
updates.summary: DLP now prevents Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data in external web searches, mitigating data leakage risks during AI interactions. This real-time control extends DLP enforcement to Copilot's external search capabilities.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Hard Delete for OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: Compliance admins can now permanently delete content in OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows with mandatory multi-admin approvals (three approvals required). This provides controlled permanent deletion for regulatory compliance while preventing accidental data loss.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP – Policies for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: DLP policies can now protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft applications like Box and Google Workspace using existing Defender for Cloud Apps connectors. This extends DLP classification and enforcement beyond Microsoft 365 workloads.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels – Auto-Labeling Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now run in simulation mode to identify matching items without enforcing labels, letting admins validate policy logic before enforcement. A new Insights tab shows policy performance metrics and source distribution.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels – Auto-Labeling for Non-Microsoft Apps
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies now support non-Microsoft connected apps including Box and Google Workspace, using the same classification engine as Microsoft 365. Organizations can extend label protection and classification to external cloud applications.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP – Sensitive Data Protection in Text and Prompts via Global Secure Access
updates.summary: DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, preventing sensitive data sharing with untrusted cloud apps. This includes detection via Insider Risk Management for risky user activity.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP – Classification Failure Detection in Exchange Online
updates.summary: Exchange Online DLP policies can now detect classification failures (timeouts, throttling, scanning errors) and apply different protection actions using the DocumentScanFailures condition. Admins gain visibility into when scans fail and can respond appropriately.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Priority Cleanup Requires Three Approvals
updates.summary: Priority cleanup policies now mandate three separate approvals before permanent deletion: one Priority Cleanup admin, one retention manager, and one eDiscovery admin. This multi-approval requirement strengthens controls and prevents accidental data loss.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling – Label Removal and Downgrade Support
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now remove or downgrade sensitivity labels on content, expanding label management beyond apply-only operations. This gives admins more control over label lifecycle and remediation workflows.
